empty: No tasks yet. Add a task to get started.
notificationBody: Open VerveTwoDo to review your tasks.
notificationSent: Notification scheduled. Check your system notification settings if it does not appear.
error: The operation could not be completed. Your saved tasks remain on this computer.
notificationError: Notifications are unavailable. Check system notification permissions and try the installed app.
helperError: The local task service could not be started. Check that the application is fully installed.
deleteTagBody: Remove this tag from all tasks? Your tasks will be kept.
noTags: Create a tag to organize your tasks.
createTagsHint: Create tags in the Tags view, then assign them here.
title: Title
markdownHint: Markdown supported: **bold**, *italic*, # headings, and lists. Formatting appears when viewing the task.
discardBody: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
deleteBody: They will be removed from your lists. You can undo this action.
emptyClearsDate: Leave empty to remove the date and recurrence.
invalidTitle: Enter a title of at most 16,000 characters.
invalidTask: Check the task fields and try again.
invalidDate: Enter a valid date using YYYY-MM-DD.
invalidTime: Enter a valid time (HH:MM) and time zone.
invalidRecurrence: Choose a due date and an interval from 1 to 999.
invalidChecklist: Each checklist step needs a unique identity and nonempty text. Limit: 500 steps.
invalidTag: Use a unique name and a six-digit hexadecimal color.
taskChanged: This task changed while you were editing. Your draft is kept; reopen the task to review the latest version.
undone: The last change was undone. Later edits were preserved.
undoUnavailable: This change can no longer be undone because the task was edited again.
widgetRefreshError: Saved. The widget could not be refreshed; try again.
importBody: Add the tasks from this backup as new tasks? Existing tasks will be kept. Importing the same file again adds another copy.
invalidBackup: This is not a valid desktop backup, or it exceeds 3 MB. Choose a VerveTwoDo desktop JSON backup.
exportError: The file could not be saved. Choose a writable folder and try again.
quitBody: An edit is in progress. Quitting discards unsaved changes. Wait for any save to finish.
reminderHint: Notify me on the due date, at the task time or the default time. Open the app regularly to refresh the next 60 reminders.
advanceMinutes: Also remind me this many minutes before
advanceHint: 0 means due time only. Maximum: 10,080 minutes (one week).
reminderBody: Open VerveTwoDo to view this task.
storageLimit: This change exceeds the 3 MB task-data limit. Shorten the notes or choose a smaller backup.
syncDescription: Connect your devices with the same server and access code. Existing tasks are added to your private workspace.
syncError: Synchronization could not finish. Your local edits are saved. Check your connection or reconnect with your access code.
syncConflict: Choose a value to resolve the conflict
rolloverDefault: Roll over unfinished tasks by default
rolloverDefaultHint: Apply to new tasks. You can change this for each task. Missed tasks move to today when the app runs.
reminderWindowsHint: Keep the app running in the notification area to receive reminders. Quitting stops reminders.
syncAttentionDescription: Choose which value to keep for each conflict. Other fields stay unchanged. Your choice will be sent to your other devices.
syncFailureTitle: Your devices may be out of sync
syncFailureHint: Your edits are saved on this device. Retry, or open sync settings to check your connection.
syncPendingHint: Some changes have not reached your other devices yet.
syncChanged: This item changed on another device. Review the current versions and try again.
syncStatusCheckingHint: Checking the connection and saved changes.
syncStatusDisconnectedHint: Tasks are saved on this device. Connect to sync with your other devices.
syncStatusSyncingHint: Exchanging changes with your sync service.
syncStatusSyncedHint: This device matches the last confirmed server state. Other devices may still be offline.
syncStatusConflictHint: Different versions need your choice. Your saved edits are still available.
syncStatusOfflineHint: Your edits are saved here. Sync will retry when the connection returns.
syncStatusPendingHint: Some local changes have not yet been confirmed by the server.
syncStatusUnconfirmedHint: The sync engine has not confirmed server receipt. A connection alone does not mean your changes are up to date.
syncStatusStaleHint: The last confirmation is no longer current. Check again to know whether this device is up to date.
syncStatusErrorHint: Your local edits are saved. Retry, or check your connection in sync settings.
webSubtitle: A little space to get things done.
storageError: Your change could not be saved. Check available browser storage and try again.
storageBlocked: Close other VerveTwoDo tabs and reload.
installHint: Use your browser’s Install app or Add to Dock / Home Screen command.
webRemindersHint: Reminders work while this app is open. Connect synchronization and enable background reminders to receive browser push notifications after closing the window. Delivery depends on your browser and system notification permissions.
webWidgetHint: Use My collection as a compact, configurable task view. Browser apps cannot add a native macOS desktop widget.
disconnectHint: Local tasks stay in this browser. Signing out does not erase them.
signIn: Enter your access code again to synchronize.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait one minute and try again.
updateReady: An update is ready. Reload when your draft is saved.
upToDate: You have the latest available version.
storageBestEffort: Your browser manages storage automatically. Keep a backup of important tasks.
keyboard: Shortcuts: ⌘/Ctrl N — new task · ⌘/Ctrl F — search · ⌘/Ctrl Enter — save · Escape — close
offlineReady: Works offline after the first visit.
deleteTagConfirm: Delete this tag? Tasks will be kept.
syncWebDescription: Use the same private access code as your Mac or Android app. Your tasks merge with that workspace.
webError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
backupImportConfirm: Import this backup as new tasks? Existing tasks will be kept.
checkUpdatesError: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
syncPrivacy: Your private access code is sent only to this app’s server.
pushEnabled: Background reminders are enabled for synchronized tasks. Renew your sync session if you are asked to sign in again.
pushUnavailable: Background reminders could not be enabled. Check browser permissions and synchronization. On iPhone or iPad, install the app on the Home Screen first.
pushUpdateError: Background reminder settings could not be updated. Reconnect and try again.
widgetHint: Keep your tasks on your desktop with the VerveTwoDo Widgets companion. It syncs on its own, and opening a task brings you back here.
widgetInstalled: VerveTwoDo Widgets is installed. Update it from its menu, or download it again below.
widgetOfferMac: Show your tasks in macOS widgets.
widgetOfferWindows: Show your tasks in the Windows Widgets board.
widgetMacStep1: Open the download, then open VerveTwoDo Widgets. It moves itself to Applications.
widgetMacStep2: If macOS says it cannot verify the app, open System Settings › Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway (asked only once).
widgetMacStep3: Connect with your access code, then add VerveTwoDo from Edit Widgets.
widgetWindowsStep1: Open the downloaded installer. If Windows SmartScreen warns about an unrecognized app, choose More info, then Run anyway, and approve the next prompt (asked only once).
widgetWindowsStep2: Connect with your access code when VerveTwoDo Widgets opens.
widgetWindowsStep3: Open the Widgets board (Windows + W) and add VerveTwoDo.
widgetMacCommand: Quickest: open Terminal (in Applications › Utilities), paste this command and press Return. It downloads, verifies and installs the widget.
widgetCopied: Command copied. Paste it in Terminal.
widgetCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the command and copy it.
